notes: defaultRemoteUrl is null by design: operators set ZAVORTH_PLUGIN_MARKETPLACE_URL (or inject remoteUrl at runtime). Example placeholder: https://cdn.example.com/zavorth/plugin-catalog.json
Remote catalogs must be HTTPS JSON arrays (or { entries: [] }). See config/plugin-marketplace-remote.example.json.
Signed packs follow docs/plugin-os-signed-pack.md (manifest zavorth.plugin-os.v1 + digest/signature fields).
Local config/plugin-marketplace-curated.json always wins on id conflicts over remote/cache entries.
Remote/community packs are never auto-enabled as first-party; enable remains explicit after install + verify.
SSRF guards reject localhost, private hosts, and non-HTTPS schemes during marketplace refresh.
